# How to Write a Book Now

> A comprehensive resource for aspiring authors covering novel writing, character development, story structure, and the publishing process using Dramatica Theory.

Created by Glen C. Strathy, How to Write a Book Now provides practical guides and frameworks for emerging writers at all levels. The site emphasizes story structure theory, character creation, and revision techniques to help authors complete and publish their work.

## Key Topics

- Novel Writing
- Story Structure
- Character Development
- Dramatica Theory
- Creative Writing
- Fiction Writing
- Plot Development
- Writing Craft
- Genre Writing
- Revision and Editing
- Publishing
- Aspiring Authors
- Writing Techniques
- Dramatica Software
- Beginner Writing Guide

## Getting Started as a Writer

- [How to Write a Book Now -- Tools for Emerging Authors](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com): Homepage for How to Write a Book Now by Glen C. Strathy
- [How to Become a Writer: Where to Start](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/how-to-become-a-writer.html): Beginner guide to becoming a writer from scratch
- [Creative Writing Tips](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/creative-writing-tips.html): Creative writing tips using Dramatica Theory approach
- [Writing Games for Adults to Find Ideas and Inspire Creativity](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/writing-games-for-adults.html): Writing exercises and games for adult creativity and idea generation

## Novel Writing Fundamentals

- [How to Write a Novel](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/how-to-write-a-novel.html): Guide to writing novels with plot, characters, and themes
- [How to Structure a Story](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/how-to-structure-a-story.html): Story structure theories from Aristotle to Dramatica framework
- [Creating Fictional Characters](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/creating-fictional-characters.html): Tips for creating realistic and archetypal fictional characters
- [The Setting of a Novel and How to Choose It](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/setting-of-a-novel.html): Guide to deciding novel settings with examples like The Shining
- [How to Write with Style](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/how-to-write-with-style.html): Techniques to improve fiction writing style and prose

## Genre and Format Guides

- [All About Writing Genres](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/writing-genres.html): Guide to popular writing genres and their unique traits
- [How to Write a Series](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/to-write-a-series.html): Tips for writing related novel series by Glen C. Strathy
- [Writing Nonfiction: Another Way to Become a Professional Writer](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/writing-nonfiction.html): Guide to nonfiction writing as a path to professional writing
- [How to Write a Play: Some Tips](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/write-a-play.html): Playwriting tips for solid plot structure and dramatic writing

## Revision, Editing, and Publishing

- [How to Revise a Novel](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/how-to-revise-a-novel.html): Guide to revising and self-editing novels after writing
- [Simple Steps to Getting Published](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/getting-published.html): Guide to publishing steps for novels and nonfiction books

## Reference and Analysis

- [Sample Story Analyses](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/story-analyses.html): Sample story analyses using Dramatica software framework

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [Questions About Novel Writing](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/questions-about-novel-writing.html): FAQ section for novel writing questions and answers
- [Your Plot Questions Answered](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/plot-questions.html): FAQ section answering plot development questions
- [Your character questions](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/character-questions.html): FAQ section for fictional character development questions
- [Your Genre Questions](https://www.how-to-write-a-book-now.com/genre-questions.html): FAQ section answering genre selection and blending questions
